note_en: Formal Chinese often uses 被称为 "is called, is known as" to introduce a nickname: 这部法律…被称为"史上最严"环保法 "this law has been called the strictest environmental law in history." Unlike English, the passive marker 被 here needs no agent; and in titles of laws and plans, note the book-title marks 《》, which Chinese uses where English would use italics or capitals.
